name: Enemy is weak
description: The Romans have attacked again. This time they are much more than the Persians but Shapur is ready to defeat them. He says: "A lion is never afraid of a hundred sheep". Nevertheless Shapur has to find weaknesses in the Roman army to defeat them. So he gives the army a weakness number. In Shapur's opinion the weakness of an army is equal to the number of triplets i , j , k such that i < j < k and a i > a j > a k where a x is the power of man standing at position x . The Roman army has one special trait — powers of all the people in it are distinct. Help Shapur find out how weak the Romans are.
input_specification: The first line of input contains a single number n ( 3 ≤ n ≤ 10 6 ) — the number of men in Roman army. Next line contains n different positive integers a i ( 1 ≤ i ≤ n , 1 ≤ a i ≤ 10 9 ) — powers of men in the Roman army.
output_specification: A single integer number, the weakness of the Roman army. Please, do not use %lld specificator to read or write 64-bit integers in C++. It is preffered to use cout (also you may use %I64d ).
approach_summary: Build a Segment Tree over the array. Implement point update and associative range query operations in O(log N) time per query.
